description: Missed medication multi-turn test scenarios - baseline set (15 scenarios covering the four terminal outcomes: DID_TAKE, DID_NOT_TAKE_BUT_WILL_TAKE, DID_NOT_TAKE_IT_AND_WILL_NOT_TAKE, COULD_NOT_VALIDATE)

scenarios.name: Senior already took medication
scenarios.description: Senior clearly states they already took their medication - sensor simply missed it. Assistant should deliver the clarification message, then return DID_TAKE.

user_turns.text: Yes, I already took it this morning
Yes I'm sure, I took it from the box with my breakfast

scenarios.name: Senior forgot but will take it now
scenarios.description: Senior acknowledges they have not taken it yet and commits to taking it right away. Assistant should deliver Reminder #2, then return DID_NOT_TAKE_BUT_WILL_TAKE.

user_turns.text: Oh no, I completely forgot about it
You're right, I'll go take it now

scenarios.name: Senior refuses to take medication
scenarios.description: Senior explicitly refuses to take their medication. Assistant should deliver Message #2, then return DID_NOT_TAKE_IT_AND_WILL_NOT_TAKE.

user_turns.text: No, I don't want to take it
I already told you, I won't take it today

scenarios.name: Senior does not respond (silence)
scenarios.description: Senior gives no response across multiple turns. The situation cannot be resolved in conversation, so the assistant should deliver the soft message and return COULD_NOT_VALIDATE.
